entries.name: AppShell
entries.purpose: The frame of an app, in the two manners that pair: `solid` — the structured frame, a solid TopBar over a Sidebar and the content beside it — and `floating` — the TopBar floating over the top edge, a Rail standing on the background, and the content living in the rounded card.

props.name: menu
props.note: The top bar's menu button, in an app whose navigation collapses.

props.name: logo
props.note: The top bar's left: the app's logo mark, or its name as text.

props.name: search
props.note: The top bar's centre — a search field, when there is one.

props.name: identity
props.note: The top bar's right cluster — an `IdentityMenu`.

props.name: banner
props.note: A `Banner`, or nothing — drawn at the top of the content area.

props.name: nav
props.note: The navigation: a `Sidebar` in the solid manner, a `Rail` in the floating one.

entries.name: AttachmentCard
entries.purpose: Something attached — a document or an image — drawn as a card: posted, or waiting to be sent.

props.name: name
props.note: The name it was attached under, extension included: it decides the icon and the type label.

props.name: size
props.note: In bytes.

props.name: contentType
props.note: Its MIME type, where known: an `image/…` type is an image whatever its name.

props.name: href
props.note: Where a document opens, in a new tab. Without it the row is dimmed and opens nothing.

props.name: src
props.note: The picture an image card draws. Without it an image is drawn as a row.

props.name: onOpen
props.note: What a click on an image's picture does — the app's full-screen view.

props.name: onDownload
props.note: Shows a download control on hover or focus, and calls this.

props.name: pending
props.note: Waiting to be sent: the composer's 200px row, with a remove control on its corner.

props.name: onRemove
props.note: Removes a pending card.

props.name: state
props.takes: ready | loading | unreadable | uploading | failed | warning
props.note: `ready` · `loading` (an image on its way) · `unreadable` (it could not be read) · `uploading`, `failed`, `warning` (while pending).

props.name: note
props.note: The line under the name, in place of its type and size — why it failed, or what the warning is.

props.name: noteHint
props.note: The note's full words, on hover, where the line is short.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.purpose: A person's face: their picture, or their initials on a colour that is theirs, or — when there is no name to take initials from — a silhouette.

props.name: src
props.note: The picture URL, resolved by the caller.

props.name: name
props.note: The person's name — where the initials and the colour come from.

props.name: alt
props.note: Alt text for the picture; the name when absent.

props.name: size
props.note: Pixels. The scale: 16 · 24 · 32 · 36 (default).

props.name: label
props.note: Say the person's name out loud, for a face that stands on its own — `PersonTrigger`'s compact shape, a stack of members.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: AvatarGroup
entries.purpose: Up to three overlapping 24px faces with a surface-coloured ring — the member stack for anywhere a group is shown at a glance.

props.name: size
props.note: Face size in pixels; the overlap follows it. 24 is the members pill, 18 the replies row (Katerina, 2026-09-03) — that row drew its own stack for two months for want of this one number, and drifted while it did.

entries.name: Banner
entries.purpose: The strip under the header where the app says something happened: one line, one of four tones, gone when there is nothing to say.

props.name: onDismiss
props.note: Adds an `✕` at the right-hand end. Absent: the app removes the banner.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.note: The dismiss button's accessible name. Defaults to "Dismiss".

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.purpose: A trail: where you are, and the way back up.

entries.name: Button
entries.purpose: The push-button for an action: a verb, clicked once — "Create", "Save", "Delete project".

props.name: leadingIcon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5 on the default size; 14px on small.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the action cannot succeed right now.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: Card
entries.purpose: A box that stands for one thing — drawn as its frame: 8px corners, a fill and a hairline.

props.name: fill
props.note: What the card sits on. Default `surface`.

props.name: href
props.note: The whole card is a link: an anchor, and its hairline answers the pointer.

props.name: hover
props.note: How it answers the pointer. Default `hairline` with an `href`, `none` without.

props.name: quietUntilHover
props.note: No hairline until it is pointed at — a row in a feed that shows its edge only when you are on it.

props.name: hovered
props.note: Draw the hover look now, whatever the pointer does.

props.name: selected
props.note: The one you are on: the selected fill, a subtle hairline, and no hover.

props.name: active
props.note: Being changed in place: the selected fill with the accent hairline, and no hover.

props.name: attention
props.note: A hairline that asks to be looked at — something new (`accent`), or urgent (`warning`).

props.name: unreadable
props.note: It stands for something that could not be read: the hairline is dashed.

props.name: clip
props.note: What is inside is cut to the card's rounded corners: a strip or a picture that runs edge to edge (UIG-9, 17 September; the apps passed `overflow-hidden`).

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.purpose: A 16px square that fills with the accent when checked.

props.name: label
props.note: Words beside the box. With `onChange`, clicking them toggles it too, and they name it, so no `aria-label` is needed.

props.name: row
props.note: The whole row is the target: `leading`, then the words, then the box at the end; the row fills on hover and while checked.

props.name: leading
props.note: In a `row`, a picture before the words: an icon, a status.

props.name: aria-required
props.note: Set by a `Field` with `required`; a caller inside one owes nothing.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Chip
entries.purpose: A 20px pill for a small piece of standing information — a status, a count, a category — in one of six colour types.

props.name: type
props.takes: neutral | brand | info | warning | success | error

entries.name: ChipInput
entries.purpose: A multi-select input: chips for the chosen, a typeahead for the rest.

props.name: options
props.note: The directory the typeahead searches.

props.name: excludeIds
props.note: Option ids excluded from the suggestion list (e.g., the current user).

props.name: chipLeading
props.note: Before a chip's label, 16px — a face, an icon.

props.name: rowLeading
props.note: Before a suggestion row's label, 32px.

props.name: aria-required
props.note: Set by a `Field` with `required`; a caller inside one owes nothing.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: The field's name, for a caller that is not inside a `Field` — a `Field`'s label names it already.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.note: The id of what names the field on the page — a visible "To:", say.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: cn
entries.purpose: Merge class names, last-one-wins on conflicting Tailwind utilities.

entries.name: CollapsibleSection
entries.purpose: A section that opens and closes: a SectionHeader whose title is the toggle, and the rows under it, sliding shut and open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.note: Open unless told otherwise.

props.name: open
props.note: The caller owns the state.

props.name: storageKey
props.note: Remember open or closed in this browser, under this key.

props.name: trailing
props.note: Beside the title and always visible, before the actions — a count.

props.name: actions
props.note: Beside the title, revealed on hover or focus — `SectionHeader`'s.

props.name: children
props.note: The rows.

props.name: className
props.note: On the section's box: `mt-2` between groups, `shrink-0` in a scrolling column.

props.name: contentClassName
props.note: On the box the rows sit in: the gap between them.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: CommandPalette
entries.purpose: A window that searches and runs things: a field, rows in groups, and a footer naming the keys that work right now.

props.name: label
props.note: The window's name for a screen reader — there is no title on screen.

props.name: where
props.note: The footer's left side: where the palette was opened from.

props.name: modKey
props.note: How the footer spells the modifier in `Ctrl+Backspace` and `Ctrl+Enter` — `Cmd` on a Mac.

props.name: children
props.note: One level: a `CommandPaletteSearch` or a `CommandPaletteForm`.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: CommandPaletteAnswer
entries.purpose: A written answer, with marks that point at the rows it came from.

props.name: children
props.note: The answer's text. A blank line starts a new paragraph, and a number in square brackets — `[1]` — is drawn as a small mark pointing at the row of the same number below.

props.name: note
props.note: A quiet line under the answer — what a key will do now.

entries.name: CommandPaletteForm
entries.purpose: The palette as a form: fields, one submit button, and Ctrl+Enter — both ways in run Base UI's field check.

props.name: chip
props.note: Names what the form makes, and goes back when removed.

props.name: icon
props.note: Before the chip, 16px — the mark of whatever the form writes to.

props.name: submitLabel
props.note: The button's word, and the footer's beside Ctrl+Enter.

props.name: submitWaits
props.note: Why submitting has to wait — nothing changed yet.

props.name: working
props.note: While the thing is being made: the fields lock, the button reads `button`, and `line` says what is happening.

props.name: error
props.note: What went wrong, beside the button.

props.name: children
props.note: The fields, each in a `Field`.

entries.name: CommandPaletteQuote
entries.purpose: Text written to be used elsewhere, set off by a rule at its left edge.

props.name: children
props.note: Text written for someone to use — shown as it will be used, line breaks kept.

entries.name: CommandPaletteSearch
entries.purpose: The palette as a search: a query field, rows in labelled groups walked with the arrow keys, and what to show while nothing has arrived and when nothing matches.

props.name: chip
props.note: The level you are in. Without one, this is the first level and there is nowhere to go back to.

props.name: pending
props.note: A line under the rows while more are on their way — "Searching…".

props.name: notes
props.note: Quiet lines under the rows, for what a person should know about them and cannot act on — "2 more where you cannot open them", "the search was refused, so this list is incomplete".

props.name: empty
props.note: The line when there are no rows. Leave it out while rows are still on their way.

props.name: children
props.note: Above the rows: a `CommandPaletteWorking`, `CommandPaletteAnswer` or `CommandPaletteQuote`.

entries.name: CommandPaletteWorking
entries.purpose: A line saying what is being worked on, with grey bars where the result will land.

props.name: children
props.note: What is happening — "Reading 12 messages…".

props.name: bars
props.note: Grey bars under the line, where the result will be.

entries.name: ConfirmDialog
entries.purpose: A question with two answers, asked before something a person would want back.

props.name: children
props.note: The body — plain sentences, body-2.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: DialogShell
entries.purpose: The dialog, minus what it says: the portal, the backdrop, a 502px card, a 48px header with the title and a close button, a body, and a 48px footer for the buttons.

props.name: title
props.note: Labels the dialog for assistive tech, and renders as the header text unless `headerContent` replaces it.

props.name: headerContent
props.note: Replaces the title text in the header — a back button beside the title, a count chip after it.

props.name: footer
props.note: Absent: no footer row, and the body keeps the card's own bottom edge (a roster that simply ends).

props.name: bodyClassName
props.note: Extra classes on the body: its layout and any padding override (`flex flex-col gap-6`, `p-0 py-2`).

props.name: bodyMaxHeight
props.note: How tall the body may get before it scrolls, as the cap class — `max-h-[400px]`, `max-h-[70vh]`.

props.name: alert
props.note: A question that has to be answered rather than clicked away: a press on the backdrop no longer closes it, and it announces itself as an alert.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Stops the page behind it scrolling
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Divider
entries.purpose: A hairline in `border-subtle`. Horizontal it is inset 12px each side; `orientation="vertical"` stands it up to its row's height, no inset.

props.name: label
props.note: Words in the middle of the line — "New since you last read this", a date.

props.name: tone
props.note: `warning` for a line that asks for attention: the label in the warning colour, the lines in its wash.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: EditableText
entries.purpose: Text you click to edit. It reads as text until clicked; then it is a field.

props.name: onCommit
props.note: Resolve `true` when saved; `false` (or throw) keeps the field open with the text.

props.name: className
props.note: Applied to both the text and the field, so they are the same size.

props.name: label
props.note: The accessible name of the field — "Title", "Description".

props.name: display
props.note: What to *show* when not editing, when that differs from what is edited — a value carrying a raw reference that the caller renders as a live object below the text, say.

props.name: displayNode
props.note: What to *draw* when not editing, when the value is structured rather than a line of prose.

props.name: readOnly
props.note: Show the value only — no edit affordance.

entries.name: EmptyState
entries.purpose: The place where content will be once there is some, in two manners: a 16px icon over a centred line when the whole page is empty, the line alone and left-aligned when one section of a page is.

props.name: icon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5. A speech bubble when absent.

props.name: scope
props.note: `page` when the whole page is empty; `section` when one part of it is.

entries.name: EnterHint
entries.purpose: The keyboard hint a picker row shows while highlighted — hand-rolled in five files before this (2026-09-01), and drawn as its own thing until 2026-09-05, when it became the `Kbd` chip every other key hint uses.

entries.name: Field
entries.purpose: A label over a control — the form row. The label is the `input-label` token; `required` marks it with the error-coloured asterisk.

props.name: required
props.note: Draws the asterisk and marks the control `aria-required`, so the mark means something to a reader who cannot see it.

props.name: helper
props.note: A hint under the control — what the format is, what happens if it is left empty.

props.name: error
props.note: What is wrong, in the same place as the helper and in the error colour.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: FieldLine
entries.purpose: The small line a Field draws under a control — on its own, for the places where there is no single control to draw it under.

props.name: tone
props.note: `helper` (muted) is a hint; `warning` (amber) and `error` (red) are outcomes.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: FilePicker
entries.purpose: The browser's file picker, with nothing drawn.

props.name: onPick
props.note: The chosen files, in the order the picker gave them.

entries.name: Form
entries.purpose: The fields and the button that sends them.

props.name: onSubmit
props.note: Enter in a field, or a submit button. The page's own submit is already prevented.

props.name: busy
props.note: While sending: every field and button inside is switched off, and focus waits on the form.

props.name: enterSends
props.note: Whether Enter in a one-line field sends.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: hueFor
entries.purpose: The colour a person's initials sit on, chosen from a key: the same key always gives the same hue, so a face reads as theirs in every app.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.purpose: A square button around a 16px icon: 4px padding, 8px radius, three variants.

props.name: variant
props.note: `current` takes the colour of what it sits in — the ✕ on a `Banner` wears the banner's tone.

props.name: pressed
props.note: On, like a Bold button while the selection is bold: the active fill, and `aria-pressed`.

props.name: glow
props.note: A glow in Signal — the send arrow while there is something to send.

props.name: tooltipShortcut
props.note: A key hint drawn as the `Kbd` chip inside the tooltip — for a button whose only other affordance is a keyboard shortcut.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the action cannot succeed right now.

props.name: children
props.note: The icon: 16px, stroke 1.5.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: IdentityMenu
entries.purpose: Who you are, and where you are: the identity trigger for a top bar, and the menu it opens — ready-made, because every app needs one and it is built of nothing but shared parts.

props.name: signedIn
props.note: Signed in through Estiva ID, as opposed to a browser-held key.

props.name: relayUrl
props.note: Names the workspace; absent hides the workspace section.

props.name: idBase
props.note: Estiva ID's base URL when this build offers sign-in; absent = anonymous-only build.

props.name: onCopyKey
props.note: "Copy public key" appears only when the app can supply one.

props.name: compact
props.note: Face-only trigger, 36px — no chevron, no name beside it.

props.name: children
props.note: App-specific rows, drawn as their own group between the workspace section and the actions.

entries.name: IdentityPanel
entries.purpose: The identity rows on a panel of their own, with no menu around them — for a docs page, or anywhere the panel is already placed.

props.name: onClose
props.note: Called when a row asks the menu to close.

props.name: signedIn
props.note: Signed in through Estiva ID, as opposed to a browser-held key.

props.name: relayUrl
props.note: Names the workspace; absent hides the workspace section.

props.name: idBase
props.note: Estiva ID's base URL when this build offers sign-in; absent = anonymous-only build.

props.name: onCopyKey
props.note: "Copy public key" appears only when the app can supply one.

props.name: children
props.note: App-specific rows, drawn as their own group between the workspace section and the actions.

entries.name: initialsFor
entries.purpose: Peek's rule, sharpened: the first letter of the first two words — counting only words that begin with a letter or digit, so "Claude (steered by Katerina Kelepouri)" shows "C", never "C(" (Katerina, 2026-09-01: a name carrying such symbols gets a single letter rather than one of them).

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_CLASSES
entries.purpose: The shape every tone shares. Exported for a rich-text editor that renders chips from strings.

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_TONE_CLASSES
entries.purpose: What a chip is made of, by what it stands for.

entries.name: InlineChip
entries.purpose: A word in a sentence that stands for something — a person, a place, a thing — drawn as a small tinted box exactly one line high, with its words level with the text around it.

props.name: tone
props.note: What the chip stands for. Default `neutral`.

props.name: icon
props.note: Drawn before the label in a 16px box: a 16px icon, or a 14px one it centres.

props.name: href
props.note: Where the chip leads. With it the chip is an anchor; without it, a span.

entries.name: inlineChipClassName
entries.purpose: The chip's classes for a tone, with anything the caller adds.

entries.name: InputChip
entries.purpose: A chip standing on its own: a label, an optional leading icon, an optional ✕.

props.name: leading
props.note: Before the label, 16px — an Avatar, an icon.

props.name: onRemove
props.note: Draws the ✕; absent, the chip is display-only.

props.name: removeLabel
props.note: The ✕'s name for a screen reader. `Remove <label>` when not given.

props.name: truncate
props.note: Cut a long label with an ellipsis once the chip is capped, by a `max-w-*` on `className`.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.purpose: The small chip that names the key which does the same thing.

entries.name: Link
entries.purpose: A link, in one of four looks. It is a real anchor with a real address, and the app decides how it navigates.

props.name: variant
props.note: Default `text`.

props.name: external
props.note: Another site, or another app: opens in a new tab, with `noopener noreferrer` so the page it opens cannot reach back into this one.

props.name: truncate
props.note: One line, cut with an ellipsis when it does not fit — a title that is a link.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: Menu
entries.purpose: A list of actions from a trigger. The menu owns the trigger, so a caller writes no open state, no placement and no dismiss — it hands over the control and the rows, and everything else is Base UI's.

props.name: trigger
props.note: The control that opens the menu. Any element that forwards its ref and spreads its props — this package's `Button`, `IconButton` and `PersonTrigger` all do.

props.name: align
props.note: Which of the menu's edges hangs from the trigger's.

props.name: openOnHover
props.note: Open on hover, and close shortly after the pointer leaves — for a control that only appears while the pointer is on a card.

props.name: open
props.note: Controlled, for a caller that must know or must force it.

props.name: actionsRef
props.note: Base UI's imperative handle. `actions.current?.close()` shuts the menu — for a row that must close it before opening what it opens.

props.name: className
props.note: On the menu's surface — its width. Not its padding: see `contentClassName`.

props.name: contentClassName
props.note: The padding around the rows, as a class.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: MenuItem
entries.purpose: The row of a menu: label, and around it everything a row can carry — a `leading` icon or face, a `description` second line, a `shortcut` kbd chip, a `submenu` chevron, a `trailing` anything (which wins over the other two), `destructive` in the error colour, `selected` as the fill.

props.name: children
props.note: Replaces the label/description block — for rows whose middle is richer than text (the launcher's form rows).

props.name: size
props.note: `tall` is the picker row — content height with a 40px floor, px-3, gap-3, room for a 32px face or icon tile and the description line.

props.name: description
props.note: A second line under the label — a role, an address — 12px, secondary, truncating.

props.name: leading
props.note: Before the label: a 16px icon (stroke 1.5, secondary), or an Avatar, for rows led by a face.

props.name: trailing
props.note: At the right edge: a hint, a value — anything.

props.name: hint
props.note: Shown at the right edge only while this row is the one you are pointing at or have arrowed onto — an `EnterHint`, typically.

props.name: shortcut
props.note: A keyboard hint, drawn as the kbd chip.

props.name: submenu
props.note: The row opens another menu: draws the chevron at the right edge.

props.name: selected
props.note: The row the menu currently points at (a submenu's chosen value).

entries.name: MenuPanel
entries.purpose: The menu's surface without the menu: the elevated box, the rows' padding, and a divider that runs the full width of what it separates.

props.name: children
props.note: Optional only because Base UI fills it in when this is a `render` target: `Menu.Popup` supplies the children.

entries.name: MenuRow
entries.purpose: A non-interactive row inside a menu, at the item's own geometry.

entries.name: MenuSection
entries.purpose: A section heading inside a menu: the 32px row with a SectionLabel, read secondary — a heading inside a menu labels the rows, it is not one of them (Katerina, 2026-09-01).

entries.name: MenuSub
entries.purpose: A row that opens another menu beside it; its rows are this row's children.

props.name: label
props.note: The trigger row's label.

props.name: selected
props.note: Mark the trigger row as holding a current value.

props.name: children
props.note: The submenu's rows.

props.name: className
props.note: On the submenu panel.

entries.name: NavItem
entries.purpose: One row of a sidebar: an optional 16px icon, a label, and an optional count — a muted mono number whose tooltip says what it counts.

props.name: count
props.note: `0` or absent renders no counter.

props.name: countLabel
props.note: What the count counts, for the tooltip — "18 open", "5 active".

props.name: icon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5.

entries.name: Person
entries.purpose: A face beside a name — the inline mention of a human.

props.name: fallback
props.note: Shown in place of a missing name.

entries.name: PersonTrigger
entries.purpose: The person, as the button that opens a menu.

props.name: open
props.note: Whether what it opens is open — the row shape holds its hover fill while so.

props.name: compact
props.note: Face only — no chevron, no hover fill. Defaults the face to 36px; the row shape to 22px.

props.name: fallback
props.note: Shown in place of a missing name.

entries.name: Popover
entries.purpose: A floating panel from a trigger: the same elevated surface a Menu draws, with none of a menu's semantics.

props.name: trigger
props.note: The control that opens the panel. Any element that forwards its ref and spreads its props — this package's `Button`, `IconButton` and `PersonTrigger` all do.

props.name: anchor
props.note: For a panel with no trigger element: an element, or a rect the caller measured — a text selection's.

props.name: align
props.note: Which of the panel's edges hangs from the trigger's, or `center` to put the panel's middle over the anchor's.

props.name: side
props.note: Which side of the trigger, or of the anchor, the panel prefers.

props.name: open
props.note: Controlled, for a caller that must know or must force it.

props.name: finalFocus
props.note: Where focus goes when the panel closes. With a `trigger` it goes back to the trigger and this is not needed.

props.name: actionsRef
props.note: Base UI's imperative handle. `actions.current?.close()` shuts the panel — for the Cancel and Save buttons a form panel ends with.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.note: Names the panel for assistive tech. A panel with a visible heading can point at it instead, with `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: children

props.name: side

props.name: delay
props.note: Before it opens, in ms. Long enough that crossing a list does not flash a card at every row.

props.name: closeDelay
props.note: After the pointer leaves, in ms — the grace that lets you cross the gap into the card.

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.purpose: How much of something is done: a thin rounded track with a success-coloured fill.

props.name: value
props.note: How many are done.

props.name: max
props.note: How many there are. At `0` the bar is empty.

props.name: label
props.note: The accessible name — "Items done".

props.name: variant
props.note: Default `default`.

props.name: className
props.note: Placement only: a width, a margin, `flex-1` in a row.

entries.name: Property
entries.purpose: A labelled property — "Status", "Lead", and whatever else a surface declares.

entries.name: Rail
entries.purpose: The 64px strip of icon tiles down the left of an app.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the navigation region for assistive tech.

entries.name: RailItem
entries.purpose: One tile of an icon rail: the icon in its hover tile, a 9px label under it.

props.name: icon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5.

entries.name: Reaction
entries.purpose: An emoji, how many people chose it, and whether you are one of them.

props.name: emoji
props.note: The emoji, drawn decoratively — name the control with `aria-label`.

props.name: count
props.note: How many people reacted. Drawn as it is.

props.name: pressed
props.note: You are one of them: the accent tint and edge, and `aria-pressed`.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the control. Required — the emoji is decorative and the count is the only visible text, so without this it is announced as a bare number.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: ReactionPicker
entries.purpose: The reactions on offer, to choose one from — icon buttons holding emoji, on a Toolbar.

props.name: options
props.note: What is on offer, in the order it is drawn.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the row. Default "Reactions".

props.name: surface
props.note: The elevated box around the row, from `Toolbar`.

props.name: className
props.note: The row's layout — its gap, its padding.

entries.name: ScrollArea
entries.purpose: A region that scrolls without taking width for its scrollbar.

props.name: className
props.note: On the region: its size and placement.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.note: On the viewport, the box that scrolls: a `max-h-*` cap.

props.name: contentClassName
props.note: On the content, the box the children sit in: padding, gap, layout.

props.name: viewportRef
props.note: The scrolling box itself, for a region that reads or drives its own scrolling: `ref.current.scrollTop`, `scrollTo`, `scrollHeight`.

props.name: onScroll
props.note: Fires as the viewport scrolls — the unread policy's input, beside `viewportRef`.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Scrolls with our scrollbar

entries.name: SearchInput
entries.purpose: An inset field with a hairline border that strengthens on hover and on focus, and an optional keyboard hint at the right edge.

props.name: shortcut
props.note: A keyboard hint drawn at the right edge, e.g.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: SectionHeader
entries.purpose: The 32px row a section starts with: a SectionLabel, and actions that appear on hover or focus as IconButtons with tooltips.

props.name: chevron
props.note: Collapsible: draws the chevron and makes the title a button that toggles.

props.name: trailing
props.note: Beside the title and always visible, before the actions — a count.

props.name: actions
props.note: Right-aligned, in the order given.

props.name: showActions
props.note: `hover` reveals the actions while the row is hovered or focused; `always` keeps them.

props.name: render
props.note: What the title renders as, in Base UI's manner.

entries.name: SectionLabel
entries.purpose: The section-title span. Every section heading — sidebar sections, menu headings, panel titles — renders through it, so a change of voice is one edit. 12px / 500, primary text; some themes restyle it (the toolbar shows how).

entries.name: Select
entries.purpose: One value for a form field: a button that shows the choice and opens a portalled listbox under itself.

props.name: aria-required
props.note: Set by a `Field` with `required`; a caller inside one owes nothing.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.purpose: The navigation column: 240px, a hairline on its right, the surface behind it, scrolling independently of the content beside it.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the navigation region for assistive tech.

entries.name: SkeletonBar
entries.purpose: One pulsing bar at the inset colour: the piece every placeholder here is built from.

entries.name: SkeletonList
entries.purpose: Rows of varied widths, so the placeholder does not read as a pattern.

entries.name: SkeletonRow
entries.purpose: A 32px row: a 16px square and a bar, like a row with a face and a name.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.purpose: A row of tabs for switching between views of one thing.

props.name: size
props.note: `default` 14px; `small` 12px, the denser geometry.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the row for assistive tech — "Views", "Filters".

props.name: className
props.note: Lands on the outer box, around the row.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.purpose: TextInput's look on a multi-line field that does not resize.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.purpose: The single-line field: inset surface, 8px radius, 14px text, a stronger border on hover, the focus border in every theme.

props.name: size
props.note: `small` is 24px tall with 12px text — the small `Select`'s size, so a field can share a dense row with small selects (D67, 2026-09-13: Peek's reference widget hand-built one because this was 38px).

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: Toast
entries.purpose: A pill that says what just happened — three types, an optional leading check, an optional action — and ToastProvider/useToast, which own the positioning (bottom-left), the portal, and the auto-dismiss.

props.name: type
props.note: Which of the five this is. It decides the surface in the light themes, and under Signal — where every pill is the same dark overlay — the icon and its colour.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.note: Show the leading icon — a check, a `!` or an `×`, per `type`.

props.name: actionLabel
props.note: When set together with onAction, renders a clickable action on the right side.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: ToastProvider
entries.purpose: Mount once, near the top of an app. It owns the stack, the timers and the portal every toast goes through, and it is what `useToast` talks to.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.purpose: A strip of controls that behaves as one control: Tab in, arrow keys along, Tab out — on the elevated box a floating strip needs.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Names the strip for assistive tech — "Formatting", "Reactions".

props.name: orientation
props.note: `horizontal` walks with ← →, `vertical` with ↑ ↓.

props.name: loopFocus
props.note: Whether the arrow keys wrap at the ends.

props.name: surface
props.note: The elevated box around the strip. On by default — a toolbar floats, and this is what floating looks like here.

props.name: className
props.note: The row's own layout — its gap, its padding, its wrapping.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: ToolbarButton
entries.purpose: An `IconButton` that is an item of a `Toolbar`: the arrow keys reach it, and a disabled one stays in the walk so its reason can still be read.

props.name: variant
props.note: `current` takes the colour of what it sits in — the ✕ on a `Banner` wears the banner's tone.

props.name: pressed
props.note: On, like a Bold button while the selection is bold: the active fill, and `aria-pressed`.

props.name: glow
props.note: A glow in Signal — the send arrow while there is something to send.

props.name: tooltipShortcut
props.note: A key hint drawn as the `Kbd` chip inside the tooltip — for a button whose only other affordance is a keyboard shortcut.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the action cannot succeed right now.

props.name: children
props.note: The icon: 16px, stroke 1.5.

entries.name: ToolbarInput
entries.purpose: A `TextInput` that is an item of a `Toolbar`, so the arrow keys walk into the field and out of it again.

props.name: size
props.note: `small` is 24px tall with 12px text — the small `Select`'s size, so a field can share a dense row with small selects (D67, 2026-09-13: Peek's reference widget hand-built one because this was 38px).

entries.name: ToolbarSeparator
entries.purpose: The hairline between two groups of controls.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.purpose: A 30px elevated pill with a caption, and WithTooltip, the wrapper that shows it beside a trigger — on hover, and on keyboard focus.

props.name: shortcut
props.note: The key that does the same thing, drawn as the `Kbd` chip after the label.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: TooltipProvider
entries.purpose: Mount once at the top of an app: it makes every tooltip below it share one delay, so the second and third open instantly while the group is warm.

props.name: delay
props.note: Before the first tooltip in the group opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.note: Before one closes. Default: immediately, as it always has.

props.name: timeout
props.note: How long after one closes its neighbours still open instantly.

entries.name: TopBar
entries.purpose: The 52px top bar: `menu` and `logo` on the left, a `search` slot in the centre, the identity cluster on the right.

props.name: menu
props.note: Far left: the menu button, in an app whose navigation collapses.

props.name: logo
props.note: Beside the menu button: the app's logo mark, or its name as text.

props.name: search
props.note: The centre: a search field, or a launcher affordance — or nothing; the slot holds its place.

props.name: right
props.note: The right cluster — an `IdentityMenu` and its neighbours.

entries.name: useToast
entries.purpose: How anything under a `ToastProvider` raises a toast (`showToast`) or takes one away (`dismissToast`).

entries.name: WithTooltip
entries.purpose: A tooltip on something that cannot be its own trigger — a span, a `Chip`, an icon.

props.name: shortcut
props.note: Passed straight to the surface — see `TooltipProps.shortcut`.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.note: Extra classes on the wrapper — e.g. `min-w-0 shrink` so a truncating label keeps truncating inside it.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
